facility_description: The Sloan Digital Sky Survey is operated by an international collaboration of scientists at many institutions.
notes: Curve-specific redistribution rights and provenance remain unresolved. Current SDSS policy declares public-release data public domain, separately from its image-only CC-BY policy; applicability to these response curves, particularly primed filter-only entries, is not established. The legacy SDSS-I/II credits page still displays commercial-use restrictions for archive data; do not silently resolve that historical/current policy distinction as a curve licence. The full acknowledgement above is reproduced from the expressly requested SDSS-I/II acknowledgement. Current collaboration page directs users of previous survey phases to their phase-specific acknowledgements. Instrument description, filter/calibration papers and band metadata remain to be researched; no speculative assignments to primed versus unprimed profiles are supplied.
